name: amfx-claims-vs-nfp-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p1): US Initial Claims vs Nonfarm Payrolls monthly change overlay. NFP is 86% noise, 14% signal — Claims are cleaner and more timely. Both series normalized to percentile rankings. Claims inverted so correlation is visible. Period: 1996-2019 (excludes COVID distortion). Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: INITIAL CLAIMS VS NONFARM PAYROLLS (25OCT22 p1)
# =============================================================================
# "NFP is 86% noise and 14% signal" — Brent Donnelly
# Orange line: NFP month-over-month change (noisy)
# =============================================================================

# Total Nonfarm Payrolls (monthly, FRED: PAYEMS) — level in thousands
payems_src = economic_indicators(series_id='PAYEMS')()

# Compute month-over-month change in thousands
nfp_change = returns(type=ReturnsType.monetary)(payems_src.result)
nfp = ffill(nfp_change)

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Nonfarm Payrolls: Monthly Change (Noisy Signal)',
    category='Claims vs NFP',
    y_axis_label='NFP Change (thousands)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NFP Monthly Change', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, nfp)
